tZh: 关于 AI 发展的公开信
sEn: Open letters on AI development reflect industry pushback against potential US restrictions on open-weight models, citing innovation and safety concerns.
sZh: 关于 AI 发展的公开信反映了业界对美国可能限制开放权重模型的反对，强调创新与安全考量。
absEn: I wrote this summary of the past few weeks of open letters as a section of my sponsors-only newsletter, but I've decided to share it here as well. Open Weights and American AI Leadership was shepherded by Microsoft, dated July 24th, and signed by 235 AI-adjacent companies including NVIDIA (see Jensen's first ever tweet), Amazon, Y Combinator, The Linux Foundation, and (a later signer) OpenAI. It's clearly an argument designed to counter any instincts by the current US government to ban or limit open-weight models over "safety" concerns - a reasonable consideration given what happened to Claude Fable 5!
absZh: 我撰写了这份关于过去几周公开信的摘要，作为我仅限赞助人阅读的新闻通讯的一部分，但我决定也在此分享。由微软主导的《开放权重与美国 AI 领导力》信函，日期为 7 月 24 日，已有包括英伟达（见黄仁勋的首条推文）、亚马逊、Y Combinator、Linux 基金会以及（后来签署的）OpenAI 在内的 235 家 AI 相关公司签署。这显然是为了反驳当前美国政府因“安全”担忧而禁止或限制开放权重模型的任何倾向——考虑到 Claude Fable 5 的遭遇，这种担忧是合理的。

contrib.en: Summarizes three 2026 open letters shaping the debate over open-weight models and frontier AI pacing.
contrib.zh: 梳理 2026 年三封公开信，勾勒开放权重模型与前沿 AI 节奏之争。

contrib.en: Open Weights letter, signed by 235 companies, argues closed models create single points of failure.
contrib.zh: 开放权重公开信获 235 家公司联署，主张闭源模型造成单点故障。

contrib.en: It contends open weights let broad communities audit behavior, find vulnerabilities and build safeguards.
contrib.zh: 该信认为开放权重让广泛社区审查行为、发现漏洞并构建防护措施。

contrib.en: The letter defends distillation as legitimate model development, not misappropriation.
contrib.zh: 公开信为蒸馏正名，视其为正当模型开发手段而非盗用。

contrib.en: Anthropic's counter-position warns of authoritarian misuse and calls for cracking down on industrial-scale distillation.
contrib.zh: Anthropic 反驳立场警告威权滥用，呼吁打击工业级蒸馏操作。

contrib.en: Pacing the Frontier, signed by 1,324 frontier employees, urges international governance to deliberately pace automated AI development.
contrib.zh: 《为前沿定速》获 1324 名前沿员工联署，呼吁国际治理刻意放缓自动化 AI 研发。

limits.en: The piece is a newsletter summary of advocacy letters, not original empirical research.
limits.zh: 本文是对倡议信件的通讯摘要，并非原创实证研究。

limits.en: Signatory counts and company positions reflect a single moment and may shift quickly.
limits.zh: 联署数量与公司立场仅反映一时，可能迅速变化。

limits.en: Arguments for open weights rest on asserted safety benefits without quantified evidence.
limits.zh: 开放权重的安全论据多为断言，缺乏量化证据支撑。

limits.en: Anthropic's dissent shows no consensus on distillation and open-weight risk tradeoffs.
limits.zh: Anthropic 的异议表明蒸馏与开放权重风险权衡尚无共识。

limits.en: Pacing proposals lack concrete mechanisms for enforcement or international coordination.
limits.zh: 定速倡议缺乏可执行的落实机制与国际协调方案。

full.secZh: 关于 AI 发展的公开信

paras.en: _I wrote this summary of the past few weeks of open letters as a section of my sponsors-only newsletter but I've decided to share it here as well._
paras.zh: _我把过去几周公开信的这份总结写成了仅赞助者可见的通讯中的一个章节，但我决定也在这里分享出来。_

paras.en: Open Weights and American AI Leadership was shepherded by Microsoft, dated July 24th, and signed by 235 AI-adjacent companies including NVIDIA (see Jensen's first ever tweet), Amazon, Y Combinator, The Linux Foundation, and (a later signer) OpenAI.
paras.zh: 《开放权重与美国 AI 领导力》由 Microsoft 牵头，日期为 7 月 24 日，由 235 家 AI 相关公司签署，包括 NVIDIA（见 Jensen 的第一条推文）、Amazon、Y Combinator、The Linux Foundation，以及（后来签署的）OpenAI。

paras.en: It's clearly an argument designed to counter any instincts by the current US government to ban or limit open weight models over "safety" concerns—a reasonable consideration given what happened to Claude Fable 5!
paras.zh: 这显然是一份旨在对抗当前美国政府以“安全”为由禁止或限制开放权重模型的任何本能的论证——考虑到 Claude Fable 5 的遭遇，这是一个合理的考量！

paras.en: Relying solely on closed models is not inherently safe: they can be breached, misused, or fail in ways that outsiders cannot detect. And concentrating advanced AI capabilities behind a small number of closed models compounds that risk. It results in a small number of single points of failure, weakens competition, and leaves critical technology in the hands of a few providers. Open weight models, on the other hand, allow a broad community of researchers and developers to examine their behavior, identify vulnerabilities, develop safeguards, and improve them over time.
paras.zh: 仅依赖闭源模型本身并不安全：它们可能被攻破、被滥用，或以外部无法察觉的方式失效。而将先进 AI 能力集中在少数闭源模型之后会加剧这一风险。这会导致少数单点故障、削弱竞争，并将关键技术交到少数提供商手中。另一方面，开放权重模型允许广泛的研究者和开发者社区检查其行为、识别漏洞、开发防护措施，并随时间推移改进它们。

paras.en: The one surprising note in the letter is that it comes out in support of distillation, where models train on output from other models:
paras.zh: 这封信中唯一令人意外的一点是，它公开支持蒸馏，即模型在其他模型的输出上进行训练：

paras.en: In shaping this ecosystem, policymakers should be careful not to conflate legitimate model-development techniques with misappropriation. Distillation, or the practice of using one model’s outputs to help train or improve another, is a widely used technique for model improvement, evaluation, and validation. It reflects a long tradition of learning from, building upon, and improving existing technologies, a tradition that has helped drive innovation since the rise of the open-source software movement.
paras.zh: 在塑造这一生态系统时，政策制定者应谨慎，不要将合法的模型开发技术与不当挪用混为一谈。蒸馏，即利用一个模型的输出来帮助训练或改进另一个模型的做法，是一种广泛用于模型改进、评估和验证的技术。它反映了学习、借鉴和改进现有技术的悠久传统，这一传统自开源软件运动兴起以来一直推动着创新。

paras.en: Notably absent from the signatures: Anthropic, who published their own response "Our position on open-weights models" three days later. CEO Dario Amodei doubled down on the risk of authoritarian governments building "AI models that are more powerful than those built by the US", and models being "misused to carry out cyberattacks or biological attacks", and called for "a crack down on industrial-scale distillation operations", while also stating that "Anthropic has never advocated for a ban on open-weights models".
paras.zh: 值得注意的是，签名者中缺少了 Anthropic，他们在三天后发布了自己的回应《我们对开放权重模型的立场》。CEO Dario Amodei 强调了威权政府构建“比美国构建的模型更强大的人工智能模型”的风险，以及模型被“滥用于实施网络攻击或生物攻击”的风险，并呼吁“打击工业规模的蒸馏操作”，同时表示“Anthropic 从未主张禁止开放权重模型”。

paras.en: Then on July 28th "Pacing the Frontier" was published, featuring signatures from "1,324 employees of frontier AI companies" - with names like Jakub Pachocki (Chief Scientist, OpenAI), Ilya Sutskever (Safe Superintelligence Inc, previously OpenAI), Dario Amodei (Anthropic), Jack Clark (Anthropic) and more. Their core message:
paras.zh: 随后在 7 月 28 日，《Pacing the Frontier》发布，有“1,324 名前沿人工智能公司员工”签名——包括 Jakub Pachocki（OpenAI 首席科学家）、Ilya Sutskever（Safe Superintelligence Inc，此前在 OpenAI）、Dario Amodei（Anthropic）、Jack Clark（Anthropic）等人。他们的核心信息是：

paras.en: We request that the U.S. government support an international effort to develop the technical and governance tools needed to deliberately pace the frontier of automated AI development.
paras.zh: 我们请求美国政府支持一项国际努力，开发必要的技术和治理工具，以有意控制自动化人工智能发展的前沿。

paras.en: Their concern is intense competitive pressure combined with accelerated AI progress caused by automated AI research - and given that Anthropic produce 80% of their code with Claude Code, OpenAI had Sol reduce their end-to-end serving costs by 20%, and Kimi K3 designed a chip to serve a nano model built on its own architecture, you can see why people are taking that risk more seriously right now.
paras.zh: 他们的担忧是激烈的竞争压力加上自动化人工智能研究导致的人工智能加速进展——考虑到 Anthropic 用 Claude Code 生成了 80%的代码，OpenAI 让 Sol 将端到端服务成本降低了 20%，以及 Kimi K3 设计了一款芯片来服务基于其自身架构构建的纳米模型，你就能理解为什么人们现在更加认真地对待这一风险。

paras.en: *   Battle Drones - a vibe coded RTS with audio-based multiplayer - 20th October 2026
paras.zh: *   Battle Drones——一款以氛围编程（vibe coding）打造、支持基于音频的多人对战的 RTS 游戏——2026 年 10 月 20 日

paras.zh: *   你好 Python 3.15，再见 3.10，现在我可以使用 3.11 了——2026 年 10 月 12 日

paras.zh: *   我的博客新增了一项功能，用我的声音构建——2026 年 10 月 9 日
